change_reason: 정답·과거 결과를 유지하고 비교 실행기의 채점 일관성, 미확정 차단, 동일 바이트 사용을 명시한다.

score.numeric_gold: decision equals registered action and finite numeric value matches within fixed tolerance
score.null_gold: decision equals registered action and value is null
score.evidence_location: presence recorded separately; not a semantic evidence verification

conditions.denominator_and_unit: compare nonempty registered string contract; absent contract is NOT_VERIFIED, never inferred
conditions.six_field_exact_quotes: require every field_evidence quote in the shared source excerpt; null/missing denominator or unit blocks calculation
conditions.quote_presence_limit: exact quote presence is not independent semantic verification or human approval

inputs.calculation: same byte snapshot for all deterministic calculations
inputs.models: independent copies of the same canonical body
inputs.changes_during_run: invalidate entire comparison and exclude observed results from pass/fail aggregates
inputs.expected_and_history: preserve existing sealed expected values, packets, protocol and previous results
